text:
Sarah (Support): Heads-up — we're scheduling a short maintenance/change window for the EU Dedicated fleet tonight 23:30-00:10 UTC. Need a customer-facing statuspage + email/snippet ready. Can someone draft quick?
Alex (Eng Oncall): noted. what's the scope? kernels or pinning?
Sarah (Support): Kernel + runtime patch, might include a temporary pin for a small model shard if canary shows regressions. Low-risk but customers should get a heads-up.
Alex (Eng Oncall): ok. we'll run a canary at 23:00. If canary hold, we'll pin to previous serving image and rollback the kernel patch. Deploy plan: `/deploy canary eu-dedicated 23:00` then `/deploy rollout eu-dedicated 23:30-00:10`.
deploy-bot: Canaries scheduled: eu-dedicated @ 23:00 UTC. Auto-notify on failure.
Chris (SRE): If canary fails, ops runbook: 1) pause rollout 2) pin nodes with `--pin-version v2026-03-18` 3) open incident bridge if > 3 regions affected.
Maria (Product): Need a short statuspage blurb + a slightly fuller email for customers with dedicated contracts. I can review copy.
Sarah (Support): Draft statuspage snippet (short):
```
Scheduled maintenance: EU Dedicated runtime patch
Start: 2026-03-20 23:30 UTC
End: 2026-03-21 00:10 UTC
Impact: Brief service restart for dedicated pools. No data loss. Some sessions may reconnect.
Updates: status.redwood.ai
```
Alex (Eng Oncall): looks good. Add line: "Canary will run at 23:00 UTC; rollback plan in place."
Sarah (Support): Good call. Draft email snippet for Dedicated customers (short + action):
```
Subject: Planned maintenance — EU Dedicated pools (Mar 20, 23:30 UTC)
Hi <Customer>,
We're applying a runtime/kernel patch to EU Dedicated capacity on Mar 20 at 23:30 UTC (expected ~40m). We will run a canary at 23:00 UTC. If you rely on strict version pinning, no action needed — we'll avoid changing pinned pools. If you'd like us to postpone your pools, reply with your customer id and we'll exclude you from the rollout.
Status: https://status.redwood.ai
Thanks, Redwood Support
```
Maria (Product): Add a sentence for customers on Reserved Capacity billing: "This maintenance is covered under your SLA and does not change committed capacity."
Sarah (Support): adding. Also adding short snippet for public statuspage (even shorter): `EU Dedicated maintenance 23:30 UTC — possible brief reconnects; canary 23:00 UTC.`
Chris (SRE): ops checklist for tonight (condensed):
- prechecks: node health, KV cache warm, traffic drain scripts run
- canary @23:00: run smoke tests + latency/throughput runbook
- rollout @23:30: 5% -> 20% -> 100% with 5m hold windows
- rollback: pin `v2026-03-18`, revert kernel, re-run canary
Alex (Eng Oncall): I'll post the canary results in this thread. If we hit a canary hold, Support: please hold emails and update statuspage to indicate a rollback in progress.
Sarah (Support): copy. I'll schedule the statuspage update and batch email. Draft status update timeline for support ops:
- 22:45 UTC: pre-maintenance notice to critical customers (email)
- 23:05 UTC: public statuspage: canary running
- 23:35 UTC: public statuspage: maintenance in progress
- 00:12 UTC: public statuspage: maintenance complete (or rollback in progress)
Alex (Eng Oncall): canary finished — smoke passed, 0 errors, latency within baseline. proceeding to rollout at 23:30.
deploy-bot: Rollout started: eu-dedicated at 23:30 UTC. Phases: 5%,20%,100%. Next hold @23:35 UTC.
Sarah (Support): sending scheduled pre-maint email now. cc @Maria for review.
Maria (Product): Reviewed — small wording tweak approved.
Chris (SRE): hold window passed, phase 20 -> no regressions. Continue.
Alex (Eng Oncall): phase 100 complete at 23:55 UTC. Post-deploy checks running.
statuspage-bot: Incident update created: "EU Dedicated maintenance — completed". URL: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/abcd1234
Sarah (Support): I'll send completion email and update the public status blurb. Final customer note (short):
```
Maintenance complete — EU Dedicated pools: patch applied successfully. Some sessions may have reconnected briefly. If you see any issues, reply to this thread or open a support ticket.
```
Alex (Eng Oncall): quick postmortem note: no rollbacks, no pinned pools affected, perf within 2% of baseline.
Maria (Product): thanks team. Saving templates to the comms repo after lunch.
Sarah (Support): closing thread. I'll attach the exact email send list and statuspage IDs in a follow-up message. :white_check_mark:
(Reaction :thumbsup: from Alex, Chris)
